answer_1.quote: We study translating unconstrained natural language statements into formal systems ... autoformalization ... generating formal Lean 4 statements.
answer_1.outputs: formal Lean 4 statements (autoformalizations of natural‑language mathematical statements)

answer_2.quote: We develop BEq+, a reference‑based metric for statement autoformalization ... we demonstrate that BEq+ correlates strongly with human annotations ... we also report type‑check rate and BLEU‑based self‑consistency metrics.

answer_4.quote: We conducted a detailed baseline study along with human evaluation of the different autoformalization methods on ProofNet# ... All predictions were annotated twice ... a single annotator ... required ~200 human‑hours.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators manually inspected each formalization for semantic correctness, completeness of hypotheses, type correctness, and overall alignment with the informal statement.
